principle: Place by observed behavior, not self-assessment. Self-assessment over-places almost everyone. Every question demands evidence, not opinion.

checks.question: Did you reach for an AI tool this week without being told or reminded to?
checks.evidencePrompt: Tell me about the last time. What was the task?

checks.question: When you ask an AI for something, do you routinely tell it the context, the task, and who the output is for?
checks.evidencePrompt: Show me (or recite) a recent prompt you actually used.

checks.question: Do you use a prompt library or shared templates — and do you maintain or curate one?
checks.evidencePrompt: Show me the library. When was it last updated, and by whom?

checks.question: Have you defined a repeatable AI workflow that someone else runs?
checks.evidencePrompt: Who runs it? Show me the documentation they run it from.

checks.question: Have you built schemas, evaluation pipelines, or governance that others operate within?
checks.evidencePrompt: Show me the artifact and name one person constrained by it.

placementRule.description: A tier is awarded only when its gate AND every lower gate passes. Higher-tier answers with failed lower gates are disregarded for placement (ambiguity routes to the lower tier by rule) and emitted as flags for coach follow-up.
placementRule.resolution: tier = 4 if tier4 else 3 if tier3 else 2 if tier2 else 1

flags.meaning: Claims system design without the fluency ladder beneath it. Verify the artifact — possible over-claim, or possible mis-scored lower checks.
Claims a workflow others run, but doesn't maintain a library or lacks Tier 2 habits. Ask who actually runs it.
Curates a library without unprompted use or structured prompts. Likely inherited ownership rather than practice — verify the update history.

routing.description: recommendedCourse = routing[tier][roleId]. Course is the bridge that STARTS at the placed tier.

notes.leader_tier2: A leader placed at Tier 2 has hit the habits half of their target (Tier 2 + Tier 4 literacy, per the role×tier matrix); the remaining program is the literacy strand. Routes to leader-literacy (D5–D7). Interim enabled-pm route retired 2026-07-10 when BACKLOG 5 shipped.
notes.tier3_non_coach_track: pm/designer/engineer/data placed at Tier 3 route to fluent-chains for artifact certification — placement is behavioral, but tier standing requires the artifacts (assessment = artifacts + observed behavior). tl/leader/coach route to native-systems, their 3→4 bridge.
notes.tier4: All roles route to native-systems. Roles outside its roleIds (pm/designer/engineer/data) join as case-study contributors / Evolution Library curator candidates rather than cohort members — coach discretion, but the course id is always valid.
